title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff to prevent regional thrashing and unintended failovers
description: Urgent stability fix for the SLO enforcer: under certain transient load patterns the backoff/hysteresis logic would oscillate and trigger rapid regional failovers and load-shedding. This change introduces an exponential smoothing window for the backoff calculation, hard minimum/maximum backoff bounds, and an ordering safeguard to prevent concurrent competing backoff updates from multiple controllers. We also add guard metrics and a safety gate that prevents automated regional failover unless sustained SLO violations exceed a configurable duration. Includes unit and integration tests, an e2e failure injection script used during the incident replay, and a feature flag to roll the fix out gradually. See linked Linear items for incident context and ramp plan.
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Fixed SLO enforcer backoff hysteresis that caused regional thrashing and unintended failovers; added smoothing, bounds, and safety gate to reduce accidental regional failovers.

merge_commit_message:
hotfix(slo-enforcer): stabilize backoff/hysteresis to prevent regional thrashing

- apply exponential smoothing to backoff calculation
- add concurrency ordering guard and bounds
- safety gate to avoid short-lived regional failovers
- tests + docs
notes: Root cause: backoff metric used instantaneous error rate and allowed rapid oscillation. The fix smooths the signal and adds a minimum sustained-violation window before triggering failover. Rollout plan: feature-flagged, canary to 10% of control plane nodes for 30 minutes, then progressively increase.
